title: there ... and it ...
subtitle: There is (есть, существует) или it (это, оно)

theory.text: there is / there are — когда сообщаем, что что-то есть, существует, впервые упоминаем: There's a new cafe on our street. it — когда говорим о конкретной уже известной вещи, месте или ситуации: We went to the new cafe. It's very cosy.
there также значит «там»: The house is empty. Nobody lives there.

items: there will be, there might be, there wouldn't be: There might be a lot of people at the party.
there must have been: There must have been somebody home.
there's bound to be / sure to be (наверняка есть), there used to be (раньше был).
Сравните: There used to be a cinema here и This building used to be a school (it/this = здание).
It's dangerous to swim here — лучше, чем To swim here is dangerous.
It took us ten minutes to get here. It's a pity you can't come. It's not worth waiting.
Расстояние, время, погода: How far is it to the sea? It's been a long time. It was windy. Но: There was a strong wind.
